#include <iostream>
#include <cmath>
#include <algorithm>

long getNumberOfDigits(long n) {
    return (long)std::floor(std::log10(n)) + 1;
}

long createSequenceOfOnes(int length) {
    long sequence = 1;
    for (int i = 1; i < length; i++) {
        sequence = sequence * 10 + 1;
    }
    return sequence;
}

long computeNumberOfOnes(long n) {
    if (n <= 6) return n;
    int digitsCount = getNumberOfDigits(n);
    long baseSequence = createSequenceOfOnes(digitsCount);
    long totalSum = baseSequence;
    int count = 0;
    long remaining = n;

    while (totalSum < n) {
        count++;
        remaining = n - totalSum;
        totalSum += createSequenceOfOnes(digitsCount);
    }

    long result;
    if (count > 0)
        result = std::min(count * digitsCount + computeNumberOfOnes(remaining),
                          (count + 1) * digitsCount + computeNumberOfOnes(totalSum - n));
    else
        result = (count + 1) * digitsCount + computeNumberOfOnes(totalSum - n);

    long nextSeq = createSequenceOfOnes(digitsCount + 1);
    if (nextSeq - n < n)
        result = std::min(result, digitsCount + 1 + computeNumberOfOnes(nextSeq - n));
    return result;
}

int main() {
    long inputNumber;
    std::cin >> inputNumber;
    std::cout << computeNumberOfOnes(inputNumber) << std::endl;
    return 0;
}
